requirements.title: Educational Qualification

requirements.title: Programming Skills
requirements.description: Familiarity with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or C).
requirements.explanation: Vipul has demonstrated proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark, which meets and exceeds the requirement for familiarity with at least one programming language.

requirements.title: Understanding of Software Development
requirements.description: Basic understanding of software development principles.
requirements.explanation: Vipul's experience in designing ETL pipelines, developing APIs, and implementing data schemas indicates a strong understanding of software development principles.

requirements.title: Communication Skills
requirements.description: Good communication skills and willingness to learn.
requirements.explanation: Vipul's CV highlights his collaborative work with analysts and his proactive communication in his cover letter, suggesting good communication skills. His eagerness to discuss his role indicates a willingness to learn.

wishes.title: Advanced Programming

wishes.explanation: While the job requires only basic familiarity, Vipul's use of multiple advanced tools and programming languages like Python, SQL, and Spark shows more than basic knowledge.

wishes.title: Experience in Software Testing
